answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The terrace of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
